Document: Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England)

==================================================
[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (a) Letter from tenant’s solicitor to landlord] Claim

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (a) Letter from tenant’s solicitor to landlord] We take the view that you are in breach of your obligations in respect of housing conditions. Please provide us with your proposals for compensation. (Alternatively, set out suggestions for general damages i.e. £x for x years). [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (a) Letter from tenant’s solicitor to landlord] Our client also requires compensation for special damages, and we attach a schedule of the special damages claimed.*

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (a) Letter from tenant’s solicitor to landlord] Yours faithfully, * Delete as appropriate

## (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Dear Sirs,

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] RE: (YOUR NAME AND ADDRESS OF PROPERTY)

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] I write regarding housing conditions at the above address. I am using the Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims – England. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] I enclose a copy of the Protocol for your information. *

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Housing Conditions

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] The following defects exist at the property (set out nature of defects). [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] I enclose a schedule of conditions which sets out the defects in each room.*

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] The history is as follows: (set out history of defects)

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] You received notice of the defects as follows: (list details of notice relied on). [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] The defects at the property are causing (set out the effects of the defects on you and your family, including any personal injury element. Specify if there will be any additional claimants). [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Please arrange to inspect the property as soon as possible. Access will be available on the following dates and times: (list dates and times as appropriate)

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Please confirm whether you intend to carry out remedial works at this stage or whether you wish to wait until the property has been inspected by the expert(s) as set out below. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] If you intend to carry out works at this stage, please set out a full schedule of intended works including anticipated start and completion dates and a timetable for the works. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Disclosure

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Please also provide within 20 working days of this letter all relevant records or documents including:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] (i) a copy of the tenancy agreement including the tenancy conditions;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] (ii) the tenancy file;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] (iii) documents relating to notice of defects given, including copies of any notes of meetings and oral discussions;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] (iv) inspection reports or documents relating to works required to the property; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] (iv) relevant computerised records. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] I enclose copies of the following relevant documents: (set out list)

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Expert

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] If agreement is not reached about the carrying out of works within 20 working days of this letter, I propose that we jointly instruct a single joint expert (insert expert’s name and address) to carry out an inspection of the property and provide a report. I enclose a copy of their CV, plus a draft letter of instruction. Please let me know if you agree to his/her appointment. If you object, please let me know your reasons within 20 working days. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] If you do not object to the expert being instructed as a single joint expert, but wish to provide your own instructions, you should send those directly to (insert expert’s name) within 20 working days of this letter. Please send me a copy of your letter of instruction. If you do not agree to a single joint expert, I will instruct (insert expert’s name) to inspect the property in any event. In those circumstances, if you wish to instruct your expert to attend at the same time, please let me and (insert expert’s name) know within 20 working days. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Claim

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] I take the view that you are in breach of your obligations relating to housing conditions. Please provide me with your proposals for compensation. (Alternatively, set out suggestions for general damages i.e. £x for x years). I also require compensation for special damages, and I attach a schedule of the special damages claimed.*

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to the landlord] Yours faithfully, * Delete as appropriate

## ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (a) Letter from tenant’s solicitor to expert

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Dear

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] RE: (TENANT’S NAME AND ADDRESS OF PROPERTY)

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] We act for the above named in connection with a housing conditions claim at the above property. We are using the Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims – England. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] We enclose a copy of the Protocol for your information.*

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Please carry out an inspection of the above property by (date)** and provide a report covering the following points:

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (a) whether you agree that the defects are as claimed;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (b) whether any of the defects is structural;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (c) the cause of the defect(s);

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (d) the age, character and prospective life of the property;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (e) a schedule of works; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] (f) an estimate of the costs of those works. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Access will be available on the following dates and times: (list dates and times as appropriate). [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] You are instructed as a single joint expert / The landlord is (landlord’s name and details) / The landlord will be providing you with their own instructions direct / The landlord will contact you to confirm that their expert will attend at the same time as you to carry out a joint inspection.*

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Please provide the report within 10 working days of the inspection. Please contact us immediately if there are any works which require an interim injunction. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] If the case proceeds to court, the report may be used in evidence. Please ensure that the report complies with Civil Procedure Rules Practice Direction 35.3 and the Guidance for the Instruction of Experts in Civil Claims (2014) https://www.judiciary.uk/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/experts-guidance-cjc-aug-2014-amended-dec-8.pdf

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] If you do not have a copy please let us know. [Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Insert details as to cost and payment

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] Yours sincerely, * Delete as appropriate ** The date to be inserted should be 20 working days from the date of the letter (b) Letter from tenant (without a solicitor) to expert

[Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims (England) > ANNEX B: LETTER OF INSTRUCTION TO EXPERT] I am currently in dispute with my landlord about housing conditions at the above property. I am using the Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Conditions Claims – England. Please ensure that the report complies with Civil Procedure Rules Practice Direction 35.3 and the Guidance for the Instruction of Experts in Civil Claims (2014) https://www.judiciary.uk/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/experts-guidance-cjc-aug-2014-amended-dec-8.pdf   If you do not have a copy please let me know.
